title: ResultSafe Core contracts and projection stabilization
summary: Governed staging work reached QUALIFIED_LOCAL_SNAPSHOT through PASS_LOCAL_ATOMIC evidence; clean commit-bound promotion remains incomplete and unauthorized.

scope: Create a strict machine-readable canonical Result Contract IR
Stabilize the complete public TypeScript Result API against the contracts
Define independent language, relational, SQLite, and AASDVGS projections
Produce traceable conformance and integrity evidence
constraints: Do not simplify the public API or omit known findings
Do not represent NOT_EXECUTED as PASS
Do not run security or long-running tests without an explicit owner command
Do not write to AASDVGS authority or transaction staging from this work

steps.description: Establish UUIDv7 allocation, reference, key, digest, and revision policies.
Define strict Draft 2020-12 schemas for every canonical document class.
Encode independent TypeScript and external AASDVGS audit evidence and findings.

Encode positive, opposite-branch, negative, type-level, and projection conformance scenarios.
Implement the reviewed TypeScript projection and execute fast conformance checks.
Implement language-neutral relational mapping and its derived SQLite profile and compiler.
Local candidate qualification complete; final promotion is not complete or authorized.
